_comment: The registry of every conversational agent the studio runs, and who it belongs to.
This file is the inventory, not a secret store. Agent ids are safe to commit: they are
already served to every visitor in the site bundle (Vite inlines VITE_* at build time),
so writing one here adds no exposure. The API key never lives in this file.
configPath is relative to the repo, and the repo is resolved under projectsDir, so this
registry stays portable to another machine. Override the base with YETI_PROJECTS_DIR.

agents.name: Manitou Beach Concierge
agents.surface: Web widget, React, @elevenlabs/react with custom card tools
agents.notes: Live since 2026-03-27. Known issues as of 2026-09-04: running a deprecated LLM (gemini-2.0-flash) and deprecated TTS (eleven_turbo_v2), guardrails off, no tests. Only getWeatherForecast is wired server-side; events is not wired and businesses is broken. The prompt carries the MAN-ih-taw pronunciation rule plus the locked Chateau Aeronautique and Men's Club naming.
